options.content:
**서버가 아는 값만 있습니다.** 화면 흐름·이탈·퍼널은 PostHog 에 있고, 일부러 안 겹치게 두었습니다.

`우리 구간 = 총 소요 − AI 소요` — 느린 게 우리인지 Bedrock 인지가 여기서 갈립니다. `session` 은 LLM 을 안 부르므로 `turn` 과 같은 축에 놓고 평균을 내면 거짓말이 됩니다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, $__interval), count(*) AS 요청 FROM analytics.demo_event WHERE event = 'web.request' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 응답속도 p95 — 경로별
panels.description: 429 는 빠져 있다. guard.rate_limited 가 따로 센다

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, $__interval), coalesce(props->>'path', '(기타)') AS metric, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (props->>'duration_ms')::int) AS p95 FROM analytics.demo_event WHERE event = 'web.request' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, $__interval), CASE WHEN (props->>'status')::int >= 500 THEN '5xx' WHEN (props->>'status')::int >= 400 THEN '4xx' ELSE '2xx' END AS metric, count(*) AS 건수 FROM analytics.demo_event WHERE event = 'web.request' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 우리 구간 vs AI 구간
panels.description: 총 소요 − AI 소요. 느린 게 우리인지 Bedrock 인지가 여기서 갈린다

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(w.occurred_at, $__interval), round(avg((w.props->>'duration_ms')::int - (a.props->>'latency_ms')::int)) AS "우리 구간", round(avg((a.props->>'latency_ms')::int)) AS "AI 구간" FROM analytics.demo_event w JOIN analytics.demo_event a ON a.session_id = w.session_id AND a.event = 'ai.responded' WHERE w.event = 'web.request' AND $__timeFilter(w.occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(props->>'path', '(기타)') AS 경로, count(*) AS 호출, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (props->>'duration_ms')::int)) AS p50_ms, round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (props->>'duration_ms')::int)) AS p95_ms, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (props->>'status')::int >= 400) AS 에러 FROM analytics.demo_event WHERE event = 'web.request' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, $__interval), props->>'step' AS metric, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (props->>'latency_ms')::int) AS p95 FROM analytics.demo_event WHERE event = 'ai.responded' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: AI 단계별 — 호출 · p50 · p95 · 최대

targets.rawSql: SELECT props->>'step' AS 단계, count(*) AS 호출, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (props->>'latency_ms')::int)) AS p50_ms, round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (props->>'latency_ms')::int)) AS p95_ms, max((props->>'latency_ms')::int) AS 최대_ms FROM analytics.demo_event WHERE event = 'ai.responded' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: 빈도 제한에 막힘
panels.description: 브라우저는 자기가 막힌 것만 안다. 전체 상한에 걸려 떨어진 사람은 여기서만 보인다

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS 건수 FROM analytics.demo_event WHERE event = 'guard.rate_limited' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
SELECT count(*) AS 건수 FROM analytics.demo_event WHERE event = 'budget.exhausted' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
SELECT count(*) AS 건수 FROM analytics.demo_event WHERE event = 'upstream.failed' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
SELECT count(*) AS 건수 FROM analytics.demo_event WHERE event = 'guard.payload_too_large' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
SELECT event AS 이벤트, surface AS 출처, count(*) AS 건수, max(occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AS 마지막 FROM analytics.demo_event WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC
